186617.overview:
You are a Bounty Hunter and in your XK155 Hover-Car you travel around the city of Xcellor8 looking for criminals called Runners. When you have found and shot a Runner you can then go to the bank to collect your money as your reward. The more Runners you catch the more money you make. At the bank you must try to get to a counter as quick as possible as the reward gets lower. You have to select a queue and you can keep changing queues to move to a faster one.

Any money you collect can now be spent at the shop to upgrade your car or purchase fuel. The longer you drive the more fuel you consume so you must keep an eye on your fuel gauge or it's game over. If you hit anything then your shield gauge will get smaller as well as your gun-charge when you use your gun. Be careful not to hit any innocent droids as they need to be taken to a hospital to repair if you have enough money. Hit three droids and it's game over.

Xcellor8 is a multi-scrolling game with the screen scrolling as you move viewed from above. You control the hover-car and your droid in the bank queue with a joystick. As well as the main playing area you can also see your money, innocents hit, Runners killed, your shield, gun-charge and fuel gauges. There is also a scanner showing where the Runners and Innocent droids are.

186726.overview: Xargon Wars is a shoot-em-up in the style of the arcade game Astro Blaster where you are a gunnery commander and you must use your gun to defend your planet from wave after wave of alien invaders. There are 16 waves of aliens to blast and all aliens must be destroyed on each level to move to the next. Be careful not to over use your cannon as it can overheat and then you will have to wait for it to cool. A gauge on the right of the playing area shows your gun temperature. You can select from one to four lives and it is game over when all are lost.

186727.overview: Your people have won the war against Xargon and now in one last attack you have been tasked to destroy their planet and their four satellite planets in your spacecraft. Problem is, the Xargon's have been warned you are coming and so have sent all their Warriors to defend the planets against your attack. Xargon's Revenge is a shooter viewed from the side on a single screen for each planet. You sit on the left on the screen blasting the Warriors who move from right to left in unpredictable patterns and if you touch one then you lose one of five lives. Every Warrior must be destroyed on each screen to progress to the next but it has to be done before your fuel gauge runs out. Fuel capsules though occasionally bounce towards you and if collected increase your fuel as running out of fuel loses a life.

205626.overview: Xadium has you controlling a spacecraft over the surface of a planet and underground through a network of tunnels. The first part has you viewing your craft from a 3rd person perspective and you must move left or right through gates that come towards you. You also have the ability to accelerate and brake and the gates must be completed before a clock runs out. If you hit or miss a gate then the clock decreases. The second part sees you view your craft from the side as you move through a network of tunnels looking for the exit before the clock runs out. You also have the ability to shoot any obstacles in your way.

471184.overview:
You are a lone XZAPPER, last survivor of an advanced civilization. Many centuries ago, your planet was besieged by alien hordes. Now only You remain. The aliens have the advantage of numbers but you are on home territory. 

Your objective is to destroy all the aliens on each level, and so progress through 140 different levels.

Given away with the Commodore 16 on initial release as a pack-in title.
